title: Icecrown
body: Icecrown is the frozen crown of Northrend and the Lich King's own domain. Over it rises Icecrown Citadel, the seat of the master of the Scourge, who was once Arthas Menethil, prince of Lordaeron, and three great gates bar the road to its walls. Every power that would see him ended has come: the Argent Crusade has broken through the southeastern mountains, the Knights of the Ebon Blade strike from Death's Rise and the Shadow Vault, and the gunships Skybreaker and Orgrim's Hammer hang above the battlefield.

parts.body: In the northeast the Argent Crusade has raised the grounds of a great tournament beside a new coliseum, where heroes of every banner test their skill against one another.

title: The Argent Vanguard
body: The Argent Vanguard is the Argent Crusade's walled camp in the southeast of Icecrown, raised where the Crusade forced its way into the Lich King's land after the Alliance and the Horde had failed. Highlord Tirion Fordring commands here, and the camp is besieged. Beyond the Valley of Echoes the Crusade blew the Breach through the mountain wall, and past it lies Scourgeholme, a tiered Nerubian stronghold where its first charge was thrown back.

parts.body: The Lich King answered the breach with an assault on the Vanguard itself. It broke against blessed cannons on the towers while Tirion fought on the field, and the valley was won back.
sources: quest 13036 reward text (where both failed, the Crusade succeeded; now on the defensive)

parts.body: Tirion has already named the fortress he means to raise from Scourgeholme's ground, Justice Keep, and sends to Crystalsong for stones that repel disease, rot and plague.

title: Crusaders' Pinnacle
body: Crusaders' Pinnacle is a high crag above the Breach, named by the Scourge in mockery of the Argent crusaders whose skulls they piled upon it. Whoever holds its height holds a foothold inside the walls of the Lich King's domain, and the Crusade has not forgotten what was done to its dead there.

parts.body: The Crusade took the pinnacle back with a blessed banner, and it is now its stronghold inside Icecrown, where Tirion plans the long road to the citadel's gates.

parts.body: Crusader Bridenbrad, who dragged a dozen men off the Broken Front, carried the plague of undeath. Not even Remulos or Alexstrasza could cleanse it, and at the last A'dal's blessing let him die with a smile.

title: Onslaught Harbor
body: Off Icecrown's western coast the Scarlet Onslaught holds an island harbor manned by veterans of New Hearthglen, its Crimson Cathedral reached by a single, heavily guarded entrance. On the cliff above stands Death's Rise, where the Knights of the Ebon Blade mean to end the Onslaught once and for all, raising the Scarlet dead into the very thing they hated. Somewhere on the island hides Grand Admiral Westwind.

parts.body: Westwind writes of a glorious day to come, when the Onslaught will wash over first the Lich King and then the rest of the world.
sources: npc_text 13525-13530 (Arete's tale: the remnant from New Hearthglen, end the Onslaught once and for all)

parts.body: Found in the Hidden Hollow, Westwind shed his weak little shell: the grand admiral was the dreadlord Mal'Ganis. The Scarlets had been taken in by demons yet again.

title: The Shadow Vault
body: The Shadow Vault is a Scourge stronghold cut into the mountains of northern Icecrown, where a death knight general oversees the forging of new weapons. Above its spires floats the Ocular, an eye through which the Lich King watches over the vault, and on its ledges wait three of his servants: an abomination, a banshee and a one-eyed geist.

parts.body: The vault has fallen to the Knights of the Ebon Blade: the Ocular was destroyed to blind the Lich King, his three servants were broken from his will, and the knights hold it now against the Scourge.

title: Malykriss: The Vile Hold
body: Malykriss, the Vile Hold, lies against Icecrown Citadel itself, the seat of the Lich King's metalworking, where skeletal runesmiths and saronite shapers work the forges. Its saronite comes from the Weeping Quarry southwest of the Shadow Vault, worked without rest by risen laborers, and in its yards a new generation of death knight initiates trains for the Lich King.

parts.body: The Lich King is sparing nothing to replace Acherus and the knights he lost with it. Arthas, the Ebon Blade say, did not take that loss well: the boy is not used to losing.

title: Jotunheim
body: Jotunheim is a vrykul city over the mountains west of the Shadow Vault, where its people were first reawakened. Its warriors are forever challenging one another to ascend: the victors go to Ymirheim to join the Lich King's elite, the losers are reduced to vargul. They fight in the sacred battle pit of Valhalas under a val'kyr's eye, and in the Underhalls, by the Lich King's leave, a mad scientist experiments on the vargul.

parts.body: A banshee of Quel'Thalas, freed from the Lich King's hold at the Shadow Vault, took possession of the vrykul's bone witch and in a val'kyr's guise saw Jotunheim's master fall. Her revenge, she says, is complete.

title: Ymirheim
body: Ymirheim is the great frost vrykul city at the center of Icecrown, home of the Ymirjar, the vrykul the Lich King has deemed worthy to be his chosen. Val'kyr taskmistresses drive captives into the Saronite Mines beneath it, where an unknown voice whispers of fear and betrayal in the dark, and Alliance and Kor'kron troops fight their way up the passes and drop soldiers into the city from the air.

parts.body: The captives are the Argent Crusade's own people, and those freed come back half mad, complaining of voices in their heads.

parts.body: Deep in the mines the Ymirjar keep in chains a creature that rose from below to see what the noise was, and that speaks directly into the minds of those who come near.

title: Mord'rethar, Aldur'thar and Corp'rethar
body: Three gates bar the road to Icecrown Citadel: Mord'rethar, the Death Gate, with flesh giants on its ramparts; Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate, held by the Cult of the Damned; and Corp'rethar, the Horror Gate, where the Lich King's elite form up. The field before the first is the Broken Front, strewn with the slain of both factions, and the gunships of the Alliance and the Horde hang above the gates with death knights aboard to advise them.

parts.body: The Broken Front was an Alliance assault on the gate, broken when Horde soldiers fell on it from behind, and the hatred born there now rides the gunships as surely as their war on the Scourge.

title: Icecrown Citadel
body: Icecrown Citadel, the Lich King's fortress, rises from the glacier crowned by the Frozen Throne. Below its walls an immense pit plunges several hundred feet into the ground, its purpose unknown but plainly of great importance to the Scourge, and Knights of the Ebon Blade keep watch close by. Beneath the citadel lie the Frozen Halls, the way into its depths.

parts.body: At the bottom of the pit lies Naz'anak, the Forgotten Depths, and beneath its water lies something pulsing, sealed in ice. A boy's voice warns that its owner will come looking for whoever touches it.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Icecrown_Citadel (the Frozen Throne at its summit)

parts.body: The Frozen Halls now stand open, and with them the way into the citadel itself. The assault on the Lich King's fortress has begun.

title: The Cathedral of Darkness
body: North of Icecrown Citadel spreads the Court of Bones, where overseers drive reanimated miners at their work and the dead outnumber everything else. Northwest of the citadel the Cult of the Damned keeps the Cathedral of Darkness, guarded by chosen zealots and served by acolytes.

parts.body: A Cult procession carried Arthas's heart to the cathedral, and Tirion met it in disguise. The Lich King came, Tirion struck the heart with the Ashbringer, and when he was struck down the Ebon Blade brought his party out.

title: The Argent Tournament Grounds
body: In the northeast of Icecrown the Argent Crusade has raised the grounds of the Argent Tournament, where heroes of every banner test their skill against one another to ready themselves for the common enemy, rising from aspirant to valiant to champion. The Silver Covenant speaks for the Alliance and the Sunreavers for the Horde, the Ebon Blade camps on the north side, and the Crusaders' Coliseum looms over all.

parts.body: A rider called the Black Knight killed every combatant set to face him. Orders found at his home proved him a member of the Cult of the Damned, sent by Arthas to disrupt the tournament.
sources: quest 13667 description

parts.body: Defeated in the ring, the Black Knight was carried off by cultists and reanimated for the Lich King's servants. What his master intends no one knows.
